title: Apple’s ‘new’ polishing cloth is the same except $10 cheaper
summary: The polishing cloth costs $9 instead of $19. But if you pair Apple’s new Mac Studio or Mac Mini models with a Studio Display, rest assured that you can safely use the polishing cloth to clean the screen.
